title: Escalated Idle Charges for Repeat Idling on a Parking License
content:
Community charger rules, Parking License: a vehicle that keeps a charger occupied after charging again and again pays more for the long part of its idle time.

## Rule

When two or more other idle fee lines were posted on the license in the 6 months before the handling date, every billed hour beyond the first 2 hours is charged at 1.5 times the hourly idle rate; when exactly one other idle fee line was posted on the license in those months, every billed hour beyond the first 2 hours is charged at 1.25 times the hourly idle rate; in every other case every billed hour is charged at the hourly idle rate. The hourly charges are the billed hours up to 2 at the hourly idle rate plus the billed hours beyond 2 at the escalated rate.

"Other" idle fee lines are the license's idle fee lines other than the idle fee line whose idle time is being billed.

## Escalation by history

| Other idle fee lines in the 6 months before the handling date | First 2 billed hours | Billed hours beyond 2 |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | the hourly idle rate | 1.5 times the hourly idle rate |
| exactly one | the hourly idle rate | 1.25 times the hourly idle rate |
| none | the hourly idle rate | the hourly idle rate |

## Worked examples (hypothetical: 3.5 billed hours at an hourly idle rate of $10.00)

- **Two or more other lines.** 2 hours at $10.00 make $20.00; the remaining 1.5 hours at $15.00 make $22.50; the hourly charges are $42.50.
- **Exactly one other line.** 2 hours at $10.00 make $20.00; 1.5 hours at $12.50 make $18.75; the hourly charges are $38.75.
- **No other line.** 3.5 hours at $10.00; the hourly charges are $35.00.

With 2 billed hours or fewer, every hour falls within the first 2 and the history makes no difference.
